creator.description:
This is a labeling service for those in the TTRPG Industry. It also doubles as a Job board. 

If you're looking to Playtest games, request that role to let people know you're open to test their games.

locales.description: Transforms careful experiments into strange remedies, volatile tools, and useful surprises.

locales.description: Meets danger with fierce momentum, startling endurance, and force that is difficult to stop.
locales.name: Berserker

locales.description: Carries a sacred calling through restorative rites, protective acts, and decisive miracles.
locales.name: Cleric

locales.description: Reads the field, coordinates allies, and makes a capable group work as one.

locales.description: Draws power and perspective from wild places, living cycles, weather, and change.

locales.description: Builds mastery through discipline, practiced technique, and command of arms.

locales.name: Guardian

locales.description: Refines movement, focus, and inner discipline into extraordinary action.
locales.name: Monk

locales.description: Reads signs at the edge of certainty and carries truths that rarely arrive without a cost.

locales.description: Uses disciplined thought, perception, and will to reach beyond ordinary limits.
